ammonia_saturation.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69, Ammonia, Antoine Equation Parameters
ammonia_saturation.original_reference: Stull, D.R. (1947), Vapor Pressure of Pure Substances. Organic and Inorganic Compounds, Industrial & Engineering Chemistry 39(4), 517-540
ammonia_saturation.tolerance_note: 3% is an engineering regression threshold against this older correlation, not a NIST uncertainty claim or a bound on EOS accuracy.

cold_store_processes.source: FAO, Planning and engineering data 1. Fresh fish handling, 5. Ice manufacturing equipment
cold_store_processes.use: Separately account for cooling to freezing point, phase-change latent heat and subsequent cooling. Ambient infiltration adds sensible and latent load.
cold_store_processes.parameter_status: Goods mass, water fraction, freezing temperature, UA, door coefficient, frost density and oil transport time constants are user-defined equivalent parameters; they are not measurements or a manufacturer map.

eos.use: Documents the current EOS and comparisons. CoolProp-vs-CoolProp self-consistency is not counted as an independent benchmark.
